prompt: Name a member of the original 1975 cast of Saturday Night Live.
label: Getting Harder
note: Same fix as the other rounds in this game: these were filed as extras, implying they're still correct for 'the original 1975 cast' - none of them were, which the Bill Murray fact already half-admitted ('the most common wrong answer'). Moved to distractors with bust:true.

answers.name: Chevy Chase
answers.fact: Anchored the first Weekend Update, and left after a single season.

answers.name: John Belushi
answers.fact: Auditioned by mocking the whole idea of the show, and was hired anyway.

answers.name: Dan Aykroyd
answers.fact: The only Canadian in the cast, and the youngest at 23.

answers.name: Gilda Radner
answers.fact: The first performer Lorne Michaels hired.

answers.name: Jane Curtin
answers.fact: Took over Weekend Update after Chase left, the first woman to anchor it.

answers.name: Laraine Newman
answers.fact: A founding member of the Groundlings before she joined, at 23.

answers.name: Garrett Morris
answers.fact: The only Black cast member, and a trained opera singer.

distractors.name: Bill Murray
distractors.note: The most common wrong answer - he joined in season two, replacing Chevy Chase.

distractors.name: George Coe
distractors.note: Credited on the first episode only, which is why he's usually left off the list.

distractors.name: Michael O'Donoghue
distractors.note: A writer who appeared in the very first sketch, but wasn't billed as cast.

distractors.name: Lorne Michaels
distractors.note: Created and produced the show, but was never one of the cast.

distractors.name: Al Franken
distractors.note: A writer in the first season, and a performer only later.

distractors.name: Eddie Murphy
distractors.note: Joined in 1980, five years after the original cast.
